title: Where is the connection attempted from and to?
summary: Confirm protocol, resolved address, port, and client execution context before changing services or firewalls.

title: Is the intended process listening on the expected address and port?
summary: A refusal commonly means the destination was reached but no acceptable listener handled the connection.

commands.purpose: List TCP listeners without requiring process identity.
Inspect the expected service where systemd applies.

choices.label: Bound only to loopback or wrong interface

title: Does DNS resolve to the intended destination?
summary: Wrong-address resolution can make a healthy service appear refused.

title: Is the port published and reachable on the intended Docker network?
summary: Container listeners, published host ports, and inter-container networks are different paths.

choices.label: Port mapping or network is wrong
Container process is stopped or crashing

title: Does the Service select ready endpoints on the intended target port?
summary: A Service, EndpointSlice, Pod listener, and client namespace all participate in the path.

choices.label: No usable endpoint or wrong selector

title: Diagnose the service or process lifecycle
summary: Read service/container/Pod failure evidence before restarting or changing the network.

title: Correct the intended bind address deliberately
summary: Expose only the interfaces required by the architecture; do not default blindly to 0.0.0.0.
rollback: Restore the previous bind address and configuration if exposure or service behavior is incorrect.
verification: Listener is present on the intended interface and only intended clients can connect.

title: Inspect rejection policy and protocol mismatch
summary: Check firewall reject rules, IPv4/IPv6 choice, proxy path, and TCP versus Unix-socket assumptions without disabling protections.

title: Continue with DNS resolution diagnosis
summary: Correct the destination identity before changing listeners or firewall policy.

title: Correct the confirmed Docker port or network configuration
summary: Change only the intended mapping/network and preserve the previous configuration.
rollback: Restore the previous Compose/run configuration and redeploy the last known-good mapping.
verification: Connection succeeds from the actual client context.

title: Correct the confirmed Service selector or target port
summary: Review workload labels and target ports before changing production routing.
prerequisites: Expected workload labels and ports confirmed
rollback: Restore the previous Service selector/port configuration.
verification: Ready endpoints appear and application-level health succeeds.

title: Verify transport and application health
summary: A successful TCP connection alone may not prove the application works.
verification: Connection succeeds from the original client context

title: Escalate with source, destination and refusal evidence
summary: Record protocol, hostname/IP, port, resolved address, client context, and listener evidence; redact internal identifiers.

title: Diagnosis complete
summary: The reviewed recovery checks passed. Record the cause and prevention step before closing the incident.
prevention: Document the confirmed cause and exact recovery.
Add monitoring or a regression check where practical.
